parameters.subject: Payment Issue - Let's fix this together
parameters.text:
Hi {{$json.customerName}},

We noticed your recent payment of {{$json.amount}} {{$json.currency}} didn't go through.

This happens sometimes! Common reasons:
• Card expired
• Insufficient funds
• Bank security block

Please update your payment method here:
[UPDATE_PAYMENT_LINK]

Your service will continue uninterrupted for 7 days while we sort this out.

Best,
[PRODUCT_NAME] Team

parameters.subject: Important: Multiple Payment Failures
parameters.text:
Hi {{$json.customerName}},

We've noticed multiple payment failures on your account.

To avoid service interruption, please update your payment method within 48 hours:
[UPDATE_PAYMENT_LINK]

If you're experiencing financial difficulty, please reply to this email - we're happy to discuss options.

Best,
[PRODUCT_NAME] Team
